Contempt Of Courts Act R/W Article 215 Of The
Constitution Of India, Praying To Punish The Accused
No.1 And 2 For Having Wilfully Disobeyed The Order
Passed By This Hon'Ble Court In Wp No.12197/2016
Dated 20.01.2022.
 This Ccc Coming On For Orders This Day, Chief
Justice Made The Following:
 Order
This Complaint alleges violation of a learned Single Judge's order dated 20.01.2022 entered in W.P.No.12197/2016 (LA-KIADB) filed inter alia by the Complainant.
The learned Single Judge by the said order, had directed the Respondents to pass the Award in respect of the subject land within a period of six months.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the Complainant argues that 0-11 Guntas of his client's land having been taken by the Respondent - KIADB decades ago, till date NC: 2023:KHC:39573-DB nothing has been done and the same amounts to willful disobedience of the order for which the Accused should be summoned & tried for the offence punishable under Section 11 & 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971.

He draws attention of the Court to the Legal Notice dated 15.07.2022 addressed to the Accused asking them to comply with Writ.
3.
The Accused having entered appearance, have filed a Compliance Affidavit which is sworn to by Accused No.1 namely Sri. S M Shivakumar, who happens to be SLAO - II of the KIADB.
The Affidavit mentions about the Preliminary Notification dated 01.09.1969 followed by the Final Notification dated 08.02.1979.
Despite quashment of acquisition proceedings in land owner's W.P.No.16309/1979, the land was utilized and no compensation was paid.
Therefore, the order Sri. G Vishnu vs Sri .

Dr. N Shivashankar Ias on 7 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146310328/
2 whose violation is complained off came to be entered in W.P.No.12197/2016.

Learned Panel Counsel appearing for the Accused submits that the Final Notification has been issued on 20.03.2019 and Award has been passed on 03.10.2023 and further, Award Notice has been issued to the Complainant on 10.10.2023.
It is also stated that the compensation awarded in a sum of Rs.21,709/- has been deposited with the Reference Court on 02.11.2023.
The order of the Court is complied with, is true.

However, the land of the citizen was taken without due process of law way back in the year 1969 when Right to Property was still a Fundamental Right guaranteed under Article 19(1)(f)of the Constitution of India.
More than half a centaury is over and twice the land owners were before this Court.
This Contempt case makes it thrice.
In the above circumstances, though there is a delayed compliance, it is not a case of willful disobedience of the order in question.

However, justice of the case warrants and accordingly we direct the Respondents to pay to the Complainant a sum of Rs.20,000/- in addition NC:
2023:KHC:39573-DB to the Award amount, within four weeks and delay will carry
additional levy of Rs.100/- per day.
We also direct the Reference Court in which the compensation amount has been deposited, to pay the said amount to the Complainant forthwith, if he moves an appropriate application in that regard.
The Court shall ensure compliance of this direction without brooking any delay.
Ordered accordingly and Notice is discharged.

Sd/-
CHIEF JUSTICE Sd/-
